headline: Executive order from 1997 bars certain business dealings and transactions involving Iran.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Bill Clinton, prohibits certain kinds of transactions involving Iran. The title does not say which transactions are covered, and no summary was provided, so the exact details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses and individuals that trade with or deal with Iran
who_it_affects.how: They are barred from certain transactions involving Iran covered by the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 19, 1997; the exact effective date is not given in the source material.
